quests.instruction: What number comes right after 12?
quests.hint: Start at 12 and take just one more step forward.
quests.explanation: Counting forward, the number right after 12 is 13 -- one more than 12!
quests.funFact: If you count backwards, 13 comes just before 14!

quests.instruction: Which word describes position number 2 in a line?
quests.hint: Count places in order: 1st, 2nd, 3rd... keep going until you reach position 2.
quests.explanation: Position 2 in a line is called the "Second" position -- ordinal words describe order, not amount!
quests.funFact: Knowing ordinal words like 'Second' helps you give exact directions!

quests.instruction: Which number is the smallest: 19, 20, or 21?
quests.hint: The smallest number is the one you'd reach first while counting up from zero.
quests.explanation: Out of 19, 20, and 21, the number 19 is the smallest!
quests.funFact: Double 19 is 38! Because 19 + 19 = 38.

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 17, 18, or 12?
quests.hint: Line all three numbers up in counting order first.
quests.explanation: Out of 17, 18, and 12, the number 18 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 18, you get 19!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 24 or 21?
quests.hint: Line the numbers up on a number line in your head -- further right is bigger.
quests.explanation: 24 is greater than 21 -- when counting up, 24 comes later!
quests.funFact: If you had 24 apples and found one more, you would have 25 apples!

quests.instruction: Which word describes position number 9 in a line?
quests.hint: This word tells you WHERE something is in line, not how many there are in total.
quests.explanation: Position 9 in a line is called the "Ninth" position -- ordinal words describe order, not amount!
quests.funFact: Words like 'Ninth' are called ordinal numbers. They tell us the order of things!

quests.instruction: Which word describes position number 9 in a line?
quests.hint: Count places in order: 1st, 2nd, 3rd... keep going until you reach position 9.
quests.explanation: Position 9 in a line is called the "Ninth" position -- ordinal words describe order, not amount!
quests.funFact: You use the word 'Ninth' to show someone's place in a line or a race!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.hint: Say the word out loud, then look for the matching numeral among the choices.
quests.explanation: "Sixteen" is how we say the number 16 in English, so 16 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: In English, the number 16 is spelled as 'Sixteen'!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Look at how many digits 15 has, then think of how that word usually sounds.
quests.explanation: The numeral 15 is written in words as "Fifteen" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: The word 'Fifteen' helps us communicate numbers without just drawing shapes!

quests.instruction: What number comes right after 12?
quests.hint: The next number is always one more than the number you're on.
quests.explanation: Counting forward, the number right after 12 is 13 -- one more than 12!
quests.funFact: If you add 0 to 13, it stays exactly the same: 13!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 18 or 14?
quests.hint: Line the numbers up on a number line in your head -- further right is bigger.
quests.explanation: 18 is greater than 14 -- when counting up, 18 comes later!
quests.funFact: The number 18 is an even number!

quests.instruction: Which word describes position number 5 in a line?
quests.hint: Think of a race -- this word describes exactly which place a runner finished in.
quests.explanation: Position 5 in a line is called the "Fifth" position -- ordinal words describe order, not amount!
quests.funFact: Words like 'Fifth' are called ordinal numbers. They tell us the order of things!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.hint: Say the word out loud, then look for the matching numeral among the choices.
quests.explanation: "Fifteen" is how we say the number 15 in English, so 15 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: Double 15 is 30! Because 15 + 15 = 30.

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 24, 17, or 18?
quests.hint: Line all three numbers up in counting order first.
quests.explanation: Out of 24, 17, and 18, the number 24 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: If you count up by ones, 24 comes right after 23!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 16 or 20?
quests.hint: Picture counting all the way up -- whichever number you'd reach later is the answer.
quests.explanation: 20 is greater than 16 -- when counting up, 20 comes later!
quests.funFact: If you count backwards, 20 comes just before 21!

quests.instruction: Is 25 an odd number or an even number?
quests.hint: Look at the very last digit of 25 -- is it 0, 2, 4, 6, or 8?
quests.explanation: 25 cannot be split into two equal groups -- there's always one left over, so 25 is Odd!
quests.funFact: If you try to split an odd number in half, you will always have one left over!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 25, 12, or 15?
quests.hint: The greatest number is the one you'd reach last while counting up from zero.
quests.explanation: Out of 25, 12, and 15, the number 25 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: Double 25 is 50! Because 25 + 25 = 50.

quests.instruction: What number comes right after 16?
quests.hint: Count up from 16: "16, ...?"
quests.explanation: Counting forward, the number right after 16 is 17 -- one more than 16!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 17, you get 18!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 16, 18, or 13?
quests.hint: The greatest number is the one you'd reach last while counting up from zero.
quests.explanation: Out of 16, 18, and 13, the number 18 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: If you had 18 apples and found one more, you would have 19 apples!

quests.instruction: Look at the number and find the matching word!
quests.hint: Count up to 16 in your head, saying each number word as you go.
quests.explanation: The numeral 16 is written in words as "Sixteen" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: When you can read big math words like 'Sixteen', you are becoming a true math master!

quests.instruction: What number comes between 23 and 25?
quests.hint: This number sits right in the middle, one more than 23 and one less than 25.
quests.explanation: 24 sits exactly between 23 and 25 -- one step up from 23 and one step down from 25!
quests.funFact: If you multiply 24 by 10, it becomes 240!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 24, 21, or 14?
quests.hint: Line all three numbers up in counting order first.
quests.explanation: Out of 24, 21, and 14, the number 24 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: If you add 0 to 24, it stays exactly the same: 24!

quests.instruction: What number comes right before 22?
quests.hint: The number right before is always one less than the number you're on.
quests.explanation: Counting backward, the number right before 22 is 21 -- one less than 22!
quests.funFact: The number 21 is an odd number!

quests.instruction: What number comes right after 21?
quests.hint: Start at 21 and take just one more step forward.
quests.explanation: Counting forward, the number right after 21 is 22 -- one more than 21!
quests.funFact: The number 22 has two digits: a 2 in the tens place and a 2 in the ones place!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.hint: Sound the word out slowly, then count that many fingers to check.
quests.explanation: "Twenty-Four" is how we say the number 24 in English, so 24 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: If you count backwards, 24 comes just before 25!

quests.instruction: Is 21 an odd number or an even number?
quests.hint: Count by twos (2, 4, 6, 8...) -- does 21 ever land exactly on one of those steps?
quests.explanation: 21 cannot be split into two equal groups -- there's always one left over, so 21 is Odd!
quests.funFact: Odd numbers always end in 1, 3, 5, 7, or 9!

quests.instruction: What number comes between 21 and 23?
quests.hint: Say the numbers in order: 21, then ..., then 23.
quests.explanation: 22 sits exactly between 21 and 23 -- one step up from 21 and one step down from 23!
quests.funFact: If you count backwards, 22 comes just before 23!

quests.instruction: Which number is smaller: 17 or 22?
quests.hint: Picture counting all the way up -- whichever number you'd reach first is the answer.
quests.explanation: 17 is smaller than 22 -- when counting up, 17 comes earlier!
quests.funFact: Double 17 is 34! Because 17 + 17 = 34.

quests.instruction: What number comes between 17 and 19?
quests.hint: This number sits right in the middle, one more than 17 and one less than 19.
quests.explanation: 18 sits exactly between 17 and 19 -- one step up from 17 and one step down from 19!
quests.funFact: If you add 1 to 18, you get 19!

quests.instruction: What number comes right after 13?
quests.hint: Start at 13 and take just one more step forward.
quests.explanation: Counting forward, the number right after 13 is 14 -- one more than 13!
quests.funFact: If you had 14 apples and found one more, you would have 15 apples!
